To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the Cloisite 5A clay is better dispersed in the recycled PET matrix than the Cloisite Na clay; (2) Cloisite 15A is better intercalated in the PET matrix than Cloisite Na, and (3) the Cloisites increase the modulus of rPET, and the Cloisite15A has the most significant reinforcing effect.
the tensile mechanical properties of the rPET/Cloisite composites are improved, especially the tensile modulus and creep resistance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of nanocomposites based on recycled poly(ethylene) terephthalates and natural montmorillonites modified with quaternium ammonium salts.
the preparation of rPET/clay nanocomposites by a melt interfacial method and the evaluation of the morphology and mechanical properties of these composites.
the preparation and characterization of nanocomposites based on recycled PET and two types of clay minerals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Cloisite 2SA is more effective than Cloisite Na in improving mechanical and thermal properties of rPET.
the Cloisite 5A nanoclay is more effective than Cloisite 10A in the improvement of the mechanical properties of PET.

the Cloisite 5A clay, which is the most effective in the rPET compositon, is able to increase the modulus of rPET by 30%, to reduce its creep, to decrease the strain at break and to have no negative effect on the yield strength of the matrix.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Cloisite 15A clay is better dispersed in the recycled poly(ethylene terphthalate) (rPET) matrix than Cloisite Na þ, and that the former clay is also more effective in increasing the tensile modulus of the r PET matrix.
the Cloisite 75A is a better reinforcing agent than Cloisite Na+ in rPET composites.
the nanocomposite of rPET with Cloisite 26A shows the best mechanical properties and dimensional stability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Cloisite 30B and Cloisite 15A are the most effective reinforcing fillers in rPET.
Cloisite 15A and Cloisite 30B have better reinforcing effect on rPET composites than Cloisite Na+.
Cloisite 75A, which is the best clay in terms of dispersion, is not the best in terms of mechanical properties.
